title: saxifraga oppositifolia subsp. latina
intro: Saxifraga oppositifolia subsp. latina, commonly known as the Alpine Saxifrage, is a plant species within the Saxifragaceae family. It is a perennial herb that grows in mountainous regions, known for its fragrant white flowers and medicinal properties. The Alpine Saxifrage has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
